title: Episode 283: From 0 Programming to NVIDIA in < 3.5 Years

sentences.en: I think I started programming around the end of 2022.

sentences.en: And I got really into CUDA.

sentences.en: And then I did my master thesis in CUDA.

sentences.en: You have to tell people to hear what NVComp is.
sentences.zh: 你得跟听众解释一下NVComp是什么。

sentences.en: Also, you may be the youngest, the youngest guest on our, or the, the, the, the first post
sentences.zh: 而且，你可能在我们播客中年纪最小，在我们播客所有的，或者说，第一个在新冠疫情

sentences.en: COVID programmer on our podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 之后才开始编程的嘉宾。

sentences.en: And wait, before we get to NVComp, I got a hundred questions.
sentences.zh: 等等，在我们聊到NVComp之前，我有一肚子问题要问。

sentences.en: This is like a, I don't want to say like rags to riches story, but you started programming like three and a half years ago and now you're working at NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 这有点像那种，我不想说是什么白手起家逆袭的故事，但你大约三年半前才开始编程，现在就已经在NVIDIA工作了。

sentences.en: Like that's absurd.
sentences.zh: 这简直太离谱了。

sentences.en: Well, first of all, what were you doing before then?
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，在那之前你都在做什么？

sentences.en: And, and second of all, like how, what are, tell the listeners, or I guess maybe most of the listeners are gainfully employed, but to the ones that aren't here, that are university
sentences.zh: 第二，你是怎么，或者说，告诉听众们，我想也许大部分听众都已经有了满意的工作，但对于那些还没毕业、还在读大学的听众来说

sentences.en: students, how does one start programming and then rapidly go through Python C++ CUDA and get a job at NVIDIA?
sentences.zh: 一个人是怎么开始编程，然后飞速通关Python、C++、CUDA，最后在NVIDIA找到工作的？

sentences.en: That's wild.
sentences.zh: 这也太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's, yeah, that's, that sounds wild to me as well.
sentences.zh: 对，这，对，听起来对我自己来说也挺疯狂的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So basically I did my bachelor's in mechanical engineering and I would say my first passion was aerodynamics.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上我的本科读的是机械工程，我的第一个挚爱可以说是空气动力学。

sentences.en: And so that's where I started.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的起步点。

sentences.en: And then I did my master's in aerospace engineering, but I basically went to a specific university
sentences.zh: 然后我读了航空航天工程的硕士，但我挑了一所很特殊的大学

sentences.en: where you could choose a lot of different subjects because right after I began my master's, I, that's when I got started into programming and I really liked it.
sentences.zh: 在那里你可以选择很多不同的学科，因为就在我开始读硕士不久后，我开始接触编程，并且非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: So I didn't know if I wanted to stay in aerodynamics or go into programming.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时不知道自己是该留在空气动力学领域，还是转行做编程。

sentences.en: And so that master's basically allowed you to do, I don't know, I did courses on quantum computing, on algorithms, on probabilistic and Monte Carlo methods, like weird stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以那个硕士项目基本上允许你做，我不知道，我选修了量子计算、算法、概率论和蒙特卡洛方法之类的课程，感觉挺奇特的。

sentences.en: Basically you could choose between a lot of stuff.
sentences.zh: 基本上你可以在很多方向里自由选择。

sentences.en: And then, yeah, basically I also got a part-time job as a programmer in Python.
sentences.zh: 然后，是的，我还找了一份Python程序员的兼职工作。

sentences.en: And then that's also where I learned a lot of stuff.
sentences.zh: 在那里我也学到了很多东西。

sentences.en: And then early on, I realized that I really enjoyed this and basically got obsessed with it and that's, that's how that, that went.
sentences.zh: 不久后，我意识到自己真的很喜欢这个，基本上到了痴迷的程度，事情就是这样一步步发展的。

sentences.en: And then, yeah, when I got to C++, I got another job.
sentences.zh: 然后，是的，当我接触到C++时，我又找了一份工作。

sentences.en: I switched jobs to another part-time job as a C++ programmer.
sentences.zh: 我跳槽到了另一家公司，做C++程序员的兼职。

sentences.en: And I think that also helped me a lot because I went into a team that was developing a library where they were going to sell the source code itself.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这也帮了我很大忙，因为我加入了一个正在开发某个库的团队，他们打算直接出售源代码本身。

sentences.en: And so they, they really took care that everything was programmed very well and very clean style, very clean way of programming.
sentences.zh: 所以他们非常注重代码的编写质量，风格非常整洁，编程方式非常规范。

sentences.en: And I learned a lot there.
sentences.zh: 我在那里学到了很多。

sentences.en: And then, yeah, I mean, when I got into CUDA, I think I was also very naive and I basically
sentences.zh: 然后，是的，当我开始接触CUDA时，我觉得自己当时也很天真，一开始被各种复杂性

sentences.en: got destroyed at the beginning with the complexities, but I just kept, kept on going, kept on going.
sentences.zh: 打击得体无完肤，但我就是不断坚持，不断尝试。

sentences.en: And then my master thesis, I also had the fortune or like the good luck that I found a very good supervisor who's a professor at Texas State University.
sentences.zh: 在做硕士论文时，我也很幸运，遇到了一位非常优秀的导师，他是德克萨斯州立大学的一位教授。

sentences.en: And he allowed me to do the master thesis with him.
sentences.zh: 他允许我和他一起完成硕士论文。

sentences.en: And I also learned a lot from, from that master thesis.
sentences.zh: 那次硕士论文的经历也让我受益匪浅。

sentences.en: And then, yeah, and then the internship, everything also lined up.
sentences.zh: 再后来，实习机会也一切水到渠成。

sentences.en: I think my, like my supervisor is someone that is somewhat well known in the data compression space, in the GPU data compression space.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的导师在数据压缩领域，也就是GPU数据压缩领域，算是一个小有名气的人。

sentences.en: So him giving good feedback on my work, I think also helped a lot for, for me to get the internship at NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 所以他对我的工作给予了很好的反馈，这也对我在NVIDIA获得实习机会起到了很大帮助。

sentences.en: And then once I was in NVIDIA, I think it was just showing that I was good enough.
sentences.zh: 到了NVIDIA之后，我觉得我只要证明自己实力足够就行了。

sentences.en: And then I guess that was the way that I got in.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我进来的方式吧。

sentences.en: I think doing an internship seems like a very good way of getting in because NVIDIA seems to be a company that either only hires interns or only hires senior people.
sentences.zh: 去实习似乎是一个非常好的敲门砖，因为NVIDIA这家公司似乎要么只招实习生，要么只招资深员工。

sentences.en: There's like a gap in between where new graduates don't really, there are not really options for that.
sentences.zh: 中间好像有个断层，应届毕业生似乎并没有太多这样的机会。

sentences.en: So I think an internship is a very good way for someone young to get into NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为对于年轻人来说，实习是进入NVIDIA的一条绝佳途径。

sentences.en: I think a lot of companies are like that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很多公司都是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, they would deny that they are, but it's just a matter of that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们嘴上会否认，但现实就是这么回事。

sentences.en: It's, you're taking a risk.
sentences.zh: 这其实是在承担风险。

sentences.en: Like it's a more certain thing if an intern has proven themselves and like a senior person has proven themselves.
sentences.zh: 如果一个实习生已经证明了自己的能力，或者一个资深人士已经证明了自己的实力，事情就会更有把握。

sentences.en: And so I do know that like new grads do get hired, but it is just much more difficult.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实知道应届生也能被录用，但要困难得多。

sentences.en: Like the company that I got hired at, they had like a massive funnel of basically co-op students and interns, interns.
sentences.zh: 比如我被录用的那家公司，他们有一个庞大的漏斗体系，专门招收合办课程的学生和实习生。

sentences.en: And like, it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 而且情况并非一成不变。

sentences.en: This may be changing because I, when I was in China, I met with one of the most AI-pilled teams at NVIDIA and the manager of the team was saying, I only hire, I love interns.
sentences.zh: 这种状况可能正在改变，因为我在中国时，遇到了NVIDIA内部最狂热拥抱AI的团队之一，该团队的经理说，我只招人，我超爱实习生。

sentences.en: I only hire interns and new college grads.
sentences.zh: 我只招实习生和应届大学毕业生。

sentences.en: I have a bunch of senior roles that I can't fill because all the senior people are not like sufficiently AI-pilled.
sentences.zh: 我手头有一堆高级岗位的名额空着填不满，因为所有的资深人士对AI的拥抱程度都不够。

sentences.en: And so I don't want to hire like a senior person when I can just keep hiring more, you know, junior people.
sentences.zh: 所以我才不想雇佣什么资深员工，我宁愿一直招募更多，你知道的，比较年轻的新人。

sentences.en: And like that, that does kind of make sense to me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这种说法确实挺有道理的。

sentences.en: The other good way to get hired at NVIDIA is be a student at the University of Waterloo and do crazy, you know, cool AI stuff and then tweet about it.
sentences.zh: 在NVIDIA获得录用的另一条好途径，就是去滑铁卢大学当学生，做那些疯狂且酷炫的AI项目，然后发推特宣传。

sentences.en: And there's like three or four of these students who've come across my desk recently.
sentences.zh: 最近我的办公桌上就刚好收到了三四个这种学生的简历。

sentences.en: And I don't know what's going on with this current class at University of Waterloo, but they're all really, really sharp.
sentences.zh: 我不知道滑铁卢大学这届学生是怎么回事，但他们真的个个都极其精明强干。

sentences.en: I mean, it's always been the case, University of Waterloo is a great school, but yeah.
sentences.zh: 当然，一直以来滑铁卢大学都是所伟大的学校，不过确实如此。

sentences.en: Did the guy that implemented HerbalQuant get a position at NVIDIA or what?
sentences.zh: 那个实现HerbalQuant的家伙在NVIDIA拿到职位了吗？还是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Can't comment, can't comment on that.
sentences.zh: 无可奉告，对此无可奉告。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, Andy and I are chatting, Andy and I are chatting.
sentences.zh: 对，对，安迪和我正在聊天，安迪和我正在聊天。

sentences.en: So wait, a couple more questions because I do find this very curious.
sentences.zh: 所以等等，我还有几个问题，因为我对这真的非常好奇。

sentences.en: You mentioned, so you were based in Madrid, then you studied in Germany, but then you mentioned your thesis advisors for your master's was at Texas State A&M.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到，你之前在马德里，然后在德国学习，但接着你又提到你的硕士论文导师在得克萨斯农工大学（Texas A&M）。

sentences.en: I know there's a bunch of, I'm not sure if I got it.
sentences.zh: 我知道有好多，我不确定我有没有听错。

sentences.en: Did I get that right?
sentences.zh: 我没记错吧？

sentences.en: University.
sentences.zh: 是大学。

sentences.en: It's a different one from A&M.
sentences.zh: 跟A&M是不同的另一所。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I know that because there's like three of them.
sentences.zh: 我知道这个，因为那边好像有三所。

sentences.en: There's also like UT Austin.
sentences.zh: 还有像德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校（UT Austin）之类的。

sentences.en: Anyways, and I always get them confused.
sentences.zh: 总之，我总是把它们搞混。

sentences.en: So it's just Texas State.
sentences.zh: 所以就是德克萨斯州立大学（Texas State）。

sentences.en: Were you still in Germany at the time or did you come to the US for your, how did that work?
sentences.zh: 当时你还在德国吗？还是说你为了这事去了美国？具体是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: No, we did it remotely.
sentences.zh: 不，我们是远程合作的。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I, yeah, when, when I did my master's thesis, I went back to Madrid because it was in the winter and winter in Germany is pretty miserable.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我要写硕士论文时，我回到了马德里，因为当时正是冬天，德国的冬天实在太惨淡了。

sentences.en: So I took the chance and I went back to Madrid and I've been in Madrid ever since.
sentences.zh: 所以我抓住机会回了马德里，从那以后我就一直呆在马德里。

sentences.en: So this was end of 2024.
sentences.zh: 所以那是2024年底的事情。

sentences.en: And so were you doing your master's just remotely from Texas State or did the Germany university have some like partnership or something?
sentences.zh: 所以你当时只是在德克萨斯州立大学远程攻读硕士学位，还是说德国的那所大学有什么合作项目之类的？

sentences.en: Not necessarily a partnership, but at, I mean, in my experience, German universities are very flexible with how you do things.
sentences.zh: 倒不一定是合作项目，但在我的经验里，德国的大学在做事方式上非常灵活。

sentences.en: And so I basically just found someone at the German university that allowed me to have an external supervisor.
sentences.zh: 所以我基本上只是在德国的大学里找了一个人，允许我拥有一位外部导师。

sentences.en: And so I just did my thesis remotely from Madrid with my supervisor in Texas.
sentences.zh: 然后我就在马德里远程完成了我的论文，由我在得克萨斯州的导师指导。

sentences.en: We just had one Zoom call every week talking about stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们每周进行一次Zoom通话讨论各种问题。

sentences.en: And then we emailed and then the guy from Germany just had to basically sign off the, sign off the thesis saying that.
sentences.zh: 然后我们通过电子邮件沟通，接着德国的那位负责人基本上只要在论文上签字认可就行了。

sentences.en: You're telling me that Germans are known for their flexibility.
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，德国人以灵活著称。

sentences.en: I know, I know it's, it doesn't sound right, but in my experience with university, they are pretty flexible.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我知道听起来不太对劲，但在我对大学的体验中，他们确实相当灵活。

sentences.en: I mean, even in university, like you can, if you want to do your bachelor's in seven years, you can do it in seven years.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，甚至在大学里，如果你想用七年时间读完本科，你也可以用七年时间读完。

sentences.en: It's your choice.
sentences.zh: 这完全取决于你。

sentences.en: You can choose how many courses you take every year.
sentences.zh: 你可以每年自己决定选几门课。

sentences.en: You can take, during your first year, you can take courses from the third year if you want.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意，你甚至可以在大一就选修大三的课程。

sentences.en: You can do everything basically as you wish.
sentences.zh: 基本上一切都随你心愿。

sentences.en: It's your own problem.
sentences.zh: 那是你自己的事。

sentences.en: And I'm just going to say, please, no angry, no angry letters for that from the Germans.
sentences.zh: 我得先声明一下，请德国的朋友们千万不要写信来抗议。

sentences.en: I guess last question, unless Bryce has got more questions about the education, because I do, I find this very fascinating.
sentences.zh: 我想这是最后一个问题了，除非布莱斯（Bryse）还有关于教育背景的其他问题，因为我对这真的非常着迷。

sentences.en: And also this is, I think like very valuable or maybe Europeans already are aware of this kind of flexibility.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得这也非常有价值，或者说也许欧洲人已经意识到了这种灵活性。

sentences.en: But when, when you were searching for your thesis advisor, were you specifically at that point, did you have like CUDA in mind and potential like jobs, you know, in this space?
sentences.zh: 但是当你在寻找论文导师的时候，你当时心里是不是就已经瞄准了CUDA以及这个领域的潜在工作机会？

sentences.en: And did you reach out specifically to that thesis advisor because of that?
sentences.zh: 你是因为这个才专门联系那位论文导师的吗？

sentences.en: Or was it for other reasons you reached out and then that kind of path just led to CUDA and NVIDIA?
sentences.zh: 还是出于其他原因联系了他，然后这段经历才恰好把你引向了CUDA和NVIDIA？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是的。

sentences.en: So I, so basically I started with CUDA beginning of 2024, middle of 2024 in a university project.
sentences.zh: 我基本上是在2024年初、2024年中旬通过一个大学项目才开始接触CUDA的。

sentences.en: And after getting into that, I knew that I wanted to do my master thesis in that.
sentences.zh: 在深入了解之后，我知道自己想以此为课题来写硕士论文。

sentences.en: And I think doing a master thesis in CUDA is quite difficult.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得要做一篇关于CUDA的硕士论文相当困难。

sentences.en: It's quite difficult to find topics for it and research groups that specialize in that.
sentences.zh: 很难找到相关的选题以及专门研究这个领域的科研团队。

sentences.en: And so I basically started looking all over Europe to see what options there were.
sentences.zh: 所以我基本上把全欧洲都找遍了，看看有哪些选择。

sentences.en: And then I came across some papers from him.
sentences.zh: 然后我偶然读到了一些他发表的论文。

sentences.en: I think I had come across a paper from him already in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我想我过去就已经读过他的一篇论文了。

sentences.en: And so I contacted him.
sentences.zh: 于是我联系了他。

sentences.en: His name is Martin Borcher.
sentences.zh: 他叫马丁·博舍尔（Martin Borcher）。

sentences.en: And then I just contacted him, sent him an email and he was kind enough to, yeah, give me an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 然后我联系了他，给他发了一封邮件，他非常友好地给了我一个机会。

sentences.en: And that's basically how it happened.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样发生的。

sentences.en: This is a, that's an amazing, I don't know if this exists in North America, but what a life hack.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一个绝妙的，我不知道北美有没有这种操作，但这简直是个生活小窍门（life hack）。

sentences.en: Like I, I'm not sure if you had a mentor or something that told you this is possible, but like, if you just stumbled onto this or maybe it's just a common thing that is like
sentences.zh: 我不太确定你当时是不是有什么导师告诉你这行得通，但如果你是自己误打误撞发现的，或者这本来就是件很普遍但又极其

sentences.en: wild, wildly, like, I don't know, like amazing or just like a focused, like you wanted to go a place you didn't find any advisors, you know?
sentences.zh: 疯狂、不可思议的事情，或者说只是因为目标明确，你想去某个地方但又找不到导师，对吧？

sentences.en: And so you just search basically the globe, tried to find folks that were doing research in this area, found one, got them to agree to be your advisor.
sentences.zh: 于是你就在全球范围内搜索，试图找到在这个领域做研究的人，找到了一个，然后说服他们同意做你的导师。

sentences.en: Note to like listeners that are, cause we like probably one of the most common questions we get is whether how do you get a job at NVIDIA or like it's some other big tech company.
sentences.zh: 给听众提个醒，因为我们经常收到的最普遍的问题之一，就是如何进入NVIDIA或其他大型科技公司工作。

sentences.en: And it's, and one of the things we always say is like, well, what do you want to do?
sentences.zh: 而我们通常会说的一点是，你究竟想做什么？

sentences.en: And it sounds like you answered that question like very quickly, or at least at some point and then went and like found someone to basically do masters with.
sentences.zh: 听起来你非常迅速地回答了这个问题，或者说至少在某个节点上确定了方向，然后就去找人合作攻读硕士学位了。

sentences.en: But that is a very fascinated by that story.
sentences.zh: 我对这个故事真的很感兴趣。

sentences.en: And I imagine there's a few people listening right now thinking like, huh, I'm in my fourth year of university.
sentences.zh: 我能想象现在肯定有好几位听众在想：啊，我正读大四呢。

sentences.en: What a interesting idea.
sentences.zh: 这主意真有意思。

sentences.en: You know, maybe they're going to go do the same thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，说不定他们也会去效仿。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Any, any follow-up questions from Bryce?
sentences.zh: 布莱斯还有什么后续问题吗？

sentences.en: Um, and also too, actually, I do have one more question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，另外，其实我还有一个问题。

sentences.en: You took a whole undergraduate degree in mechanical engineering.
sentences.zh: 你拿到了机械工程的整个本科学位。

sentences.en: Was that, was that the, uh, right engineering?
sentences.zh: 那是，那是正确的工程专业吗？

sentences.en: And they didn't have a single programming assignment or programming course or anything like that?
sentences.zh: 难道他们连一个编程作业或编程课程之类的都没有吗？

sentences.en: I see.

sentences.zh: 我应该，我应该，我还没有，我还没看过这个演示，因为我当时在中国。

sentences.en: So I have very limited background on this and also the listeners too.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想我们不能，你知道的，你只能，你得提交这个版本的某种形式，也就是当 GPU 旋转进入 thruster cub 或是我们将它放在 CCCL 某个地方并在会议上讲的那种版本，

sentences.zh: 所以一周后的内容就像是所有的性能分析，你做了大量的……我相信，

sentences.en: NCU to like measure this metric and this metric.
sentences.zh: 用 NCU 来测量这个指标和那个指标。

sentences.zh: 而且，那些东西就好像，我不是一直都在用 NSYS，但也相当频繁。

sentences.en: It's NICU, not NCO.
sentences.zh: 是 NICU，不是 NCO。

sentences.en: Is it NICU?
sentences.zh: 是 NICU 吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I've never, I've never heard it said that way in my life.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我这辈子从来没听人这么叫过。

sentences.en: I always say NCU.
sentences.zh: 我总是说 NCU。

sentences.en: Yeah, because NICU, I mean, do you say N-S-Y-S?
sentences.zh: 对啊，因为 NICU，我的意思是，你会说 N-S-Y-S 吗？

sentences.en: No, because that has a good, that has a good pronunciation.
sentences.zh: 不会，因为那个发音好听。

sentences.en: NSYS sounds good.
sentences.zh: NSYS 听起来不错。

sentences.en: NICU, NICU stands for the neonatal incubator or something.
sentences.zh: NICU，NICU 代表新生儿重症监护室（incubator）什么的。

sentences.en: It's like where the, the babies that need help in the hospital go.
sentences.zh: 就像是医院里给需要帮助的小婴儿去的地方。

sentences.en: Well, you know, the kernels.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你知道的，指那些内核（kernels）。

sentences.en: Let me, because I've been, I've been saying this a lot in our tutorials, NVIDIA has two different profilers for the compute side of things.
sentences.zh: 让我，因为我在我们的教程里经常说这个，NVIDIA 针对计算端有两个不同的性能分析器。

sentences.en: Insight Systems gives you an eagle eyes view of everything that's going on in your program.
sentences.zh: Insight Systems 让你对程序中发生的一切有一个全局的鸟瞰视角。

sentences.en: It profile, it's a sampling profiler.
sentences.zh: 它进行分析，它是一个采样分析器。

sentences.en: So it looks at what's happening to every stage of your profile of your program.
sentences.zh: 所以它会观察你的程序的每个阶段正在发生什么。

sentences.en: And then it builds up, just like in an audio editor, a bunch of different tracks showing what every process and thread is doing at any given point in time.
sentences.zh: 然后它会构建起来，就像在音频编辑器里一样，有许多不同的轨道，显示每个进程和线程在任何给定时间点在做什么。

sentences.en: It is great for identifying IO and memory movement bottlenecks, concurrency issues, et cetera, looking at overall utilization.
sentences.zh: 它非常适合识别 IO 和内存传输瓶颈、并发问题等，并查看总体利用率。

sentences.en: And it has relatively low overhead.
sentences.zh: 而且它的开销相对较低。

sentences.en: Insight Compute is a kernel level profiler.
sentences.zh: Insight Compute 是一个内核级别的分析器。

sentences.en: So it is a tool for profiling a single individual kernel or operation or multiple different kernels.
sentences.zh: 所以它是一个用于分析单个内核、操作或多个不同内核的工具。

sentences.en: And then looking at those results, it can collect a bunch of different hardware performance metrics.
sentences.zh: 然后查看这些结果，它可以收集一堆不同的硬件性能指标。

sentences.en: Like for example, L2 cache performance information, like L2 cache misses or things like how many sectors are utilized out of every L2 sector that's, that's loaded in.
sentences.zh: 比如 L2 缓存性能信息，像 L2 缓存未命中（misses），或者诸如在加载的每个 L2 扇区中利用了多少扇区之类的事情。

sentences.en: And also things like how many operations are issued per cycle, stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 还有诸如每个周期发出多少个操作之类的事情。

sentences.en: Now, collecting all these hardware performance metrics is challenging because you can only collect a few of the underlying counters at a time.
sentences.zh: 现在，收集所有这些硬件性能指标具有挑战性，因为你一次只能收集底层的几个计数器。

sentences.en: So Insight Compute will run your kernels multiple different times.
sentences.zh: 所以 Insight Compute 会多次运行你的内核。

sentences.en: It'll run your whole program multiple different times.
sentences.zh: 它会把你的整个程序运行很多次。

sentences.en: So it could be up to, you know, 40 or 50 times.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能高达，你知道的，40 或 50 次。

sentences.en: So it has a lot of overhead, but it gives you very detailed information insights into the performance of a particular kernel or algorithm in your program.
sentences.zh: 因此它有很多开销，但它为你提供了关于程序中特定内核或算法性能的非常详细的信息和见解。

sentences.en: So yes, you used a lot of, of these metrics of which to be honest, like how often Bryce, do you use NICU?
sentences.zh: 所以是的，你用了许多这样的指标，说实话，布莱斯（Bryce），你多久用一次 NICU？
